children: Boxlight regained compliance with Nasdaq's $2.5M stockholders' equity rule after completing a PIPE financing and related measures.
Nasdaq Hearings Panel determined Boxlight has regained compliance with Listing Rule 5550(b)(1) and granted continued listing.
Company presented compliance plan including a Series D convertible preferred PIPE that yielded ~ $6.6M net proceeds.
Boxlight closed Tranche One of the Series D financing on Aug 5, 2026, raising $4.8M net of fees; expects $15M equity line and $2.9M debt-to-equity swap.
Panel imposed a one-year discretionary monitor from Aug 17, 2026; failure to comply during period may lead to immediate delist determination.

title: Boxlight regains Nasdaq equity compliance after $6.6M PIPE and monitoring imposed
